parts.label: Total signed sheet charge
parts.help: d > 0; c is the signed surface-density parameter, not the speed of light.

parts.label: Axial field Ez above the sheet
parts.help: z > 0, d > 0, ε₀ > 0; c may have either sign. Supply the scalar z component, without a unit vector.

parts.label: Axial field Ez below the sheet
parts.help: z < 0; d > 0, ε₀ > 0. The normal field has no unique continuous value at z = 0.

parts.label: Effective point-charge magnitude
parts.help: Magnitude rather than signed charge; d > 0. One point charge cannot reproduce both halves of the axis.

parts.label: Effective charge z coordinate for observations above
Effective charge z coordinate for observations below
Crossing-speed infimum when qc > 0
parts.help: qc > 0; m, ε₀, d > 0. Speeds above this threshold guarantee passage; equality at the discontinuous force does not fix continuation.

parts.label: Crossing-speed infimum when qc ≤ 0
parts.help: No positive barrier. Arbitrarily small positive speeds suffice; zero is the infimum, not a guarantee of travel from infinity at rest.
